description: This file defines the ChartUtils class which provides static methods for generating bar and pie charts using the Image_Graph library, as well as a utility method for generating chart data from report query results. It encapsulates chart creation logic including data processing, label handling, styling, and rendering, tailored for integration in the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: ChartUtils
classes.description: Class providing utility methods to generate bar and pie charts for reports within the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: getBarChart
methods.description: Generates a vertical or horizontal bar chart image based on provided data and styling options.
parameters: xaxisData: array of labels for X-axis
target: array of link targets for bars

methods.name: getPieChart
methods.description: Creates a pie chart image from the provided data, with color and label management.
parameters: target: array of link targets for segments
color: color code for text and markers

methods.name: generateChartDataFromReports
methods.description: Extracts and processes report query results to produce data suitable for chart rendering, including labels, values, and links.
parameters: fieldDetails: detailed string about which field to process

methods.name: getReportBarChart
methods.description: Generates a bar chart for a specified report using query result and report parameters.

methods.name: getReportPieChart
methods.description: Generates a pie chart for a specified report using query result and report parameters.
